errors.evidence: The category "От всички" (Of all) is a summary category, not a time period, unlike "Април 2021 г." and "Август 2021 г.".
The color of the bar for the "Да" (Yes) category is teal/cyan, not "тъмносин" (dark blue).
The bars are cylindrical, meaning their tops are elliptical, not spherical ("сферични").
